newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors to raise exports to 800,000.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors to raise exports to 800,000.

text.p: Kia Motors, one of South Korea's three largest carmakers, said on Monday it would raise exports to 800,000 units by 2001 from 321,950 in 1996.
Kia said in a statement its annual overseas production would increase to 520,000 units by 2001 from 69,042 in 1996.
"We will be producing cars in 16 countries by 2001," said a Kia spokesman.
Those countries include Indonesia, Russia, China, India, Turkey and Brazil.
